classification: pre-registered regime-conditioned exposure test on the frozen hold-30 platform centre; research-only
disclosure: A scratch exploration of regime overlays was run before this pre-registration and produced no improvement over the unconditioned centre. This round is therefore a confirmation test with a fixed, disclosed hypothesis set, not a blind search; the scratch pass is recorded as already_observed.

already_observed.scratch_scope: single-atom monthly exposure scaling on the R374 platform centre, 2x cost, thresholds on lagged regime score, score change, breadth, trend score, profit score, speculation score and 20-day index momentum
already_observed.scratch_note: No scratch variant improved annual return; the best Sharpe improvement came from a breadth gate that was never binding enough to change annual return materially.

base.construction: R374 hold-30 platform centre fade05_h30_sl20 inside the frozen A/B/C pipeline: monthly 60-day inverse-vol risk parity, 10% C cap, 15% joint equity volatility target, 60-day overlay at 15%, one-third equity-weight cap, gold 200-day trend defensive bucket

mechanism: Monthly exposure scaling applied to the equity sleeve between the 15% volatility target and the three-asset defensive bucket. The defensive bucket is never scaled down, so a risk-off month moves money toward gold/treasury/dividend rather than to cash only. Turnover pays the same 0.52% round-trip cost as the other portfolio layers.

increment_over_frozen_centre.rule: annual >= base_annual - 0.005 AND (sharpe >= base_sharpe + 0.03 OR mdd >= base_mdd + 0.01)
increment_over_frozen_centre.reason: A conditioning layer must either raise risk-adjusted return or cut drawdown without giving up more than 0.5pp of annual return.

plateau.rule: at least 2 of the 3 scale levels centred on the tested level must pass every gate
plateau.reason: A single scale point that passes while both neighbours fail is a knife-edge, not a usable rule.

decision_rules: A variant advances only if it clears core_2x, rolling, increment and plateau simultaneously.
If no variant advances, the unconditioned frozen centre remains the research default and regime conditioning is recorded as negative knowledge.
If a variant advances, it still cannot be described as an independent out-of-sample finding, because the atom set was partly observed in the scratch pass.
No leverage, paper target, order or production change is permitted.
3x and 5x stress are not re-run here; R374 already covers them for the unconditioned centre.
known_limits: The regime atoms and scale levels were partly observed in a scratch pass, so this is a confirmation test rather than a blind discovery.
regime_history is a whole-market breadth/emotion series aligned by trading date; it is not a per-stock PIT dataset.
Overlapping rolling windows and a single 2022-2026 sample limit the effective evidence.
Current HS300 membership and current industry snapshot backfill remain non-point-in-time inputs.
The defensive bucket and overlay parameters are held at their R374 values; this round tests only the regime layer.
selection_rule: If more than one variant clears every gate, select the one with the highest Sharpe; if two are within 0.01 Sharpe, prefer the lower mean exposure (simpler, cheaper), then the variant with fewer distinct scale levels activated, and finally the larger threshold.

bootstrap.method: paired circular block bootstrap of the daily return difference between the conditioned equity sleeve and the frozen centre equity sleeve
bootstrap.require: P(annualised difference > 0) >= 0.60 and the 5th percentile of the annualised difference >= -0.01
bootstrap.reason: A conditioning layer must survive resampling of the realised return path, not only the realised ordering.
